parts:

Best Regards,
Jannatul

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: ctmm time-dependent raster stacks
parts:
Hi Jannatul,

This is not supported unless it's a categorical variable. You have to put the different raster layers in a named list.
In the future raster stacks will be supported, but for time dependence recorded in the z-axis.

Best,
Chris
